findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "place_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send LinkHatch an order or request. We email the owner of `email` a link to confirm it (status awaiting_confirmation); nothing is placed, charged or sent to any…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: place_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: place_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
